hooks.command: bash -c 'open=$(find tasks -name "*.md" ! -name "_*" 2>/dev/null | xargs grep -l "^status: open" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " "); ventures=$(ls ventures/*.md 2>/dev/null | grep -v "_" | wc -l | tr -d " "); echo "=== Post-compact context: holdco portfolio operator | $ventures venture(s) in ventures/ (PORTFOLIO.md) | $open open portfolio task(s) in TASKS.md | rules: AGENTS.md | log each pass to WORKLOG.md ==="'
